interest: Points to 1943–44 files on returning Japanese soldiers' ashes and treatment of Japanese war dead.
overview: Three cross-reference sheets (1943–44) on returning Japanese soldiers' ashes via the Red Cross and on press reports about treatment of Japanese war dead.

subfiles.about: Cross-reference sheet recording a letter sent to the American Red Cross concerning a proposal to repatriate the ashes of deceased Japanese soldiers.
subfiles.summary: Cross-reference to a May 24, 1943 letter to the American Red Cross on returning Japanese soldiers' ashes.
subfiles.title: State Department Cross-Reference Sheet on Proposal to Return Deceased Japanese Soldiers' Ashes

subfiles.about: Cross-reference sheet recording correspondence and clippings sent to the War Department concerning the treatment of fallen Japanese soldiers' remains.
subfiles.summary: Cross-reference to an August 19, 1944 letter to the War Department on treatment of fallen Japanese soldiers' remains.
subfiles.title: State Department Cross-Reference Sheet to the War Department on Treatment of Remains of Fallen Japanese Soldiers

subfiles.about: Cross-reference sheet recording correspondence and clippings sent to the Navy Department concerning the treatment of fallen Japanese soldiers' remains.
subfiles.summary: Cross-reference to an August 19, 1944 letter to the Navy Department on treatment of fallen Japanese soldiers' remains.
subfiles.title: State Department Cross-Reference Sheet to the Navy Department on Treatment of Remains of Fallen Japanese Soldiers
